newsitem.title: USA: Yeltsin arrives for Denver G7 meeting.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin arrives for Denver G7 meeting.

text.p: Russian President Boris Yeltsin arrived in Denver on Thursday for a summit meeting with the leaders of the world's most powerful industrial countries.

Yeltsin, attending his fifth summit of the Group of Seven, was scheduled to hold several bilateral meetings over the next two days and to attend all sessions of the summit except for a brief meeting on financial issues.
Yeltsin has said his main aim at the meeting is to win acceptance for Russia as a full member of the group, making it the Group of Eight.

"I do not want to hide from you that if the G8 question is finally resolved there, it would be a historic meeting for Russia," he told reporters before leaving Moscow. He did not speak to the press on arrival.
Japanese Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto has already signalled he does not want Russia to join the financial discussions. Yeltsin and Hashimoto are due to meet for breakfast on Friday.
The G7 comprises Britain, Canada, France, Germany, Italy, Japan and the United States.
